8.4.3 EthIf_CtrlModeIndication
[SWS_EthIf_00231] Definition of callback function EthIf_CtrlModeIndication ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_CtrlModeIndication
Syntax
void EthIf_CtrlModeIndication (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_ModeType CtrlMode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0e
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for the same CtrlIdx, reentrant for different
CtrlIdx
Index of the physical Ethernet controller within the context of the
Ethernet Interface
Parameters (in)
CtrlMode
Notified Ethernet controller mode
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Called asynchronously when mode has been read out. Triggered by previous <EthDrv>_Set
ControllerMode call. Can directly be called within the trigger functions.
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋()
[SWS_EthIf_00252] ⌈The function shall call EthSM_CtrlModeIndication.⌋()
